findings.description: The bucket is explicitly noted as public with no ACL defined to restrict access, allowing unauthenticated or unintended access to its contents, including the customer-master.xlsx object stored within it.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data in unencrypted public bucket
findings.description: A customer master data file (customer-master.xlsx), likely containing PII, is uploaded into aws_s3_bucket.data, which is both public and unencrypted, directly exposing sensitive customer information to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is specified for the financials bucket, leaving potentially sensitive financial data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is specified for the operations bucket, leaving stored data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is specified for the data_science bucket, leaving stored data unencrypted at rest.
